subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should core doctor fail closed and leave schemaless external channel config untouched when it cannot verify groupAllowFrom support?
rationale: The patch fixes a real upgrade regression, but it intentionally changes a released doctor migration write default for external plugins that core cannot introspect.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write unverified keys into external channel config.

options.title: Add External Opt-In Contract
options.body: Pause and add a plugin doctor/schema capability if non-bundled channels should opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Close or supersede only if broader config-protection work lands this same external email/RCS regression behavior and coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write unverified keys into external channel config.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and merged the original doctor fallback migration that the PR narrows.
